The FIRST test iteration ran without injection and its scripted plan hit the LIVE openrouter.ai endpoint (HTTP 401, fixture key — unauthenticated, zero spend, no key material in the repo, ~13 requests); fixed by transport injection — the committed test is fully hermetic (scripted transport, VisionCapture(null), evidence under build/tmp).
